test_title: PYST 31: SSC MTS 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 17 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Six teachers Anil, Kamal, Ram, Sanjay, Aakash and Vivek are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarilly in the same order). Ram is third to the right of vivek. vivek is second to the right of Anil. Aakash is to the immediate right of Anil. Kamal is not the immediate neighbour of Vivek. Who is the immediate neighbor of Kamal and Vivek both?
solution:
Six teachers Anil, Kamal, Ram, Sanjay, Aakash and Vivek are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarilly in the same order).

1) Ram is third to the right of vivek and vivek is second to the right of Anil.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d3ee8b305de8abc278bbb5e2dbb9b4393dab7b0e0d28a175344d0d91788af689.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/98e42836ea9efe9827830864f0fd413460d156bea61ed5e1c5a8e2da8c9bf0e4.png] 

2) Aakash is to the immediate right of Anil and Kamal is not the immediate neighbour of Vivek.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/582a68fe717e519e956baf40b4ade39d624ab6784cac60cf65551c8759062f02.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1f32fb39f5f91004534b75f07aadc7f1035fb8af21c6debf8c226ad934993f92.png] 

∴ Here, Sanjay is the immediate neighbor of Kamal and Vivek both.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Sanjay".**
